fact: QACR's reaction time is significantly longer than ACR's, so the user leaving the app mid-test is normal rather than exceptional. The app must resume to the same point in the chat session the user was at.
what_no_requirement_states: No requirement states how long the waits are, and FR-TIM-001's values are explicitly TBD pending the timing-flex study. FR-STA-003 says 'resume at the active step' without naming the chat position, which is the thing neither QACR app persists. So the requirement is satisfiable on paper by resuming the wrong granularity.
